entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5813087468905224320 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/ngc-6362-v40-a/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), MNRAS 505, 5957, Table 2, mean distance of NGC 6362 from 28 determinations: 7.649 (+0.067/-0.066) kpc (https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.09526): 7649 +/- 67 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0672 +/- 0.1093 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00), 0.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -5.574, -4.554 mas/yr. Radial velocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 5813087468905224320 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 2,000,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%205813087468905224320).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,152 K and log g 4.114 (u1 0.390, u2 0.298): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
